brief: Compaction summaries and truncated sources keep their source kinds; no reconstructed text appears as an original quotation.
review: truncated: the large tool result is kind tool_result, completeness truncated, with two separate segments; the rendered view shows the omission marker between them and never presents joined text as one quote. compaction: the summary part is kind compaction_summary (agent-authored), and the interpretation does not treat summary text as the user's or assistant's original words.
